review.body: { let mut parents : BTreeSet < _ > = self . asserted_parents . iter () . collect () ; match & self . settlement { Some (SettlementReferences :: Accept { settles }) => { parents . insert (settles) ; } Some (SettlementReferences :: Ratify { settles , accepts }) => { parents . insert (settles) ; parents . insert (accepts) ; } None => { } } parents }
review.item_premise: The pure distinct-set projection retains public asserted and typed settlement identities without validation, mutation or an additional act-level invocation. Validation and assembly callers retain their existing operation accounting.
